name: mre-bench
description:
MRE-Bench (v1)
	

MRE-Bench is a small benchmark for manufacturing reasoning focused on whether a model can make the right call:

FAIL / REDESIGN when a design/process choice has a real constraint
PROCEED / PROCEED_WITH_CONDITIONS when it's valid (even if nuanced)


	
		
		Dataset
	


Split: 80 dev (public) / 20 holdout (private)
Public dev set: data/dev.jsonl
Decision distribution (dev):
FAIL: 28
REDESIGN: 23
PROCEED: 19
PROCEED_WITH_CONDITIONS: 10


Binary split (dev): positives 51… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Assemblean/mre-bench.
reputation: A small, domain-specific benchmark aimed at manufacturing reasoning; used in specialized research but not widely adopted by the broader ML community.
